- [Add a document type](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/plugins/checkout/documents/v2/add-a-document-type.md): Add a document type: The reworked document generation is an experimental feature. - [Add Cart Items](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/plugins/checkout/cart/add-cart-items.md): Add Cart Items: This guide will show you how to create line items like products, promotion and other types and add them to the cart. It will also cover creating a custom LineItemHandler.
- [Add Cart Validator](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/guides/plugins/plugins/checkout/cart/add-cart-validator.md): Add Cart Validator: The cart in Shopware is continuously validated by so-called "validators" that check for invalid line items \(label missing\), shipping addresses, and other attributes.
